steps.text: Pop! Pop! Pop!
Bangbang! Pop!
Dadadada! Ba-bang!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Pewpewpew! Bangbang!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: One enemy left, exactly one rubber bullet left. No waste, no pollution, all emergency conserved, it's great for the environment. Whaddya think?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What a persistent fella, chasing me down three blocks and whatnot. I already told you, I don't have the goods.

steps.name: Local Ruffian
steps.text: You bitch! What are you going on about the environment for? You tryna mess with me?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Took you that long to figure out? What else was I to do? Taking out the lot of you would've been super boring.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Anyway, I guess that's game over. So like, would you care to say any last words? Speak now or forever hold your peace~

steps.name: Local Ruffian
steps.text: Stay back! Get away from me!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bang! You're dead!

steps.name: Local Ruffian
steps.text: Guh... Urgh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: —Bullseye!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Look at that impeccable aim. Good job, me! Heh, guess I'll treat myself to an extra slice of apple pie today!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Next up... back to work!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm, today's last address, Center Street No. 12-7, Ah Choi Restaurant...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, I'm sorry, did I just bump into you?

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Ah Choi Restaurant is that way. Totally opposite direction.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ah, you're right... Thanks a bunch, mister.

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Don't mention it. It's not every day I meet a fellow countryman.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (A Laterano? A Messenger, by the looks of things...)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Messages, huh...)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (It'd probably be a good idea to write home before Sauin.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We should have some stationery back at the base... Hm, guess I should pick up some souvenirs to send over with the letter.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, gotta finish work first... Now where is it, Ah Choi Restaurant...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: All right, here it is.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Excuse me. Anyone? Penguin Logistics home delivery—

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Who is it...? Woah! What happened here? What's that on the ground... is he d-dead?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hehe, it's no big deal. Don't freak out over every little corpse!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is offering a special smashed, bloody street sale! Act fast within the next three days and get our deliveries half off! Anyway, these are the goods you ordered, right?

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Express delivery?

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Wait, I don't think this is right.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: I did order something, but it's only been a few hours since I placed the order. There's no way it could've come this fast...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And that's where you're wrong. You said it's been a few hours, so getting it now sounds just about right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: After all, speed is the lifeblood of the logistics industry!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Amplifiers, lanterns, and flower baskets. Woah, are you opening a new store?

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Um, yeah...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wow, good luck! Anyway, all your stuff's right here. What's the matter, something wrong?

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: I must say, this is exactly what I ordered...

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Are you for real?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Real as the wings on my back. Intracity deliveries are a piece of cake. Would've gotten here even faster if not for those troublesome fellas lying over there on the road...

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: All righty, don't worry about it, okay? If you're good to go, please sign right here!

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Oh... Here, and here...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Very good. That's another job well done!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bye bye then! Remember to leave me a good review!

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Hey, hold on...

steps.name: Local Ruffian
steps.text: Ungh... ugh...

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Good grief... Girls these days...

steps.name: Ordinary Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: At least clean up the 'trash' you brought with you before you leave...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aaaand, that finishes up the last item!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: With that, another day of work comes to a close.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yo–– Texas, Croissant, the two of you done with work yet?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No issues here. Everything got delivered.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Got mah hands on the Baws's thing over on my end!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Some fellers tried to swipe the stuff, but I took care of 'em real good. What's so interestin' about an ol' box anyway? Ain't got a clue as to what's inside...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Maybe it's something dangerous. Either way, it's our responsibility to get rid of anyone trying to drag us down, no matter what.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Anyway, that's that. Time to head home!

steps.name: Local Ruffian
steps.text: Stop... right there...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, you were in charge over here, right? Why's this guy still able to talk?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You can't use live rounds in residential areas.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: These guys don't exactly look like gangsters either. If I don't follow the rules, things'll get pretty messy for us.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Besides, we're here to help rebuild the neighborhood and we were told not to cause any trouble. I made specially sure to avoid any vitals.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I suppose so.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Give them a lifeline, and the people here should be able to seize the opportunity and pull themselves out. Should be fine.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The last time Exusiai was able to use live rounds was when she was pickin' up that Rhodes Islander, right?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Them was some wild days! Baws sure does seem sweet on that thar Rhodes Island. I reckon we got a long 'n fruitful relationship ahead of us.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sounds about right. They've got some pretty interesting folks over there, so it's no surprise the Boss has taken a liking to them.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Enough to cause trouble.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hehe, isn't that the Boss's favorite?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You'n say that again!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But gettin' sent overseas to work sure sounds like a pain in the tail.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's pretty much the same thing we do, isn't it? Just with some extra mileage.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The salary and overtime pay there are pretty darn good too. Throw on whatever the Boss gives us over here, and it's like having twice the moolah!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No foolin'? double?! Looks like this li'l lady's about to be laughin all the way to the bank!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I wanna go, too! Exusiai, bring me along next time!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Haha, I knew that's what you'd say.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ah, crap, how'd it get this late already?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: C'mon, Texas, pick up the pace. We gotta hurry back to base before it's too late!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Get in the car. Hang on tight.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Waaaaait, hold on a sec! Okay, I'm ready! Step on it!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Where's the fire, anyway? Hey, Texas, ain't you gonna ask why she's in such a hurry?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's no way it's anything that matters.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh, good point.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, don't talk about me like I'm not here! And I'll have you know, it's super important!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If we don't get back soon, the apple pie I put in the oven's gonna burn!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: How in tarnation is that important? Woooooooahh! Texas, how fast you cornerin'——?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Too slow!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I had time to enjoy three LPs, both sides. Is it your legs, or your brain? How'd a couple of simple deliveries take that long?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Phew, thank goodness, the apple pie is safe!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mmmmh, that's the aroma I could die for! The heat's just right too, absolutely perfect!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yo! Listen to me when I'm talkin' to you!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Baws, we was floorin' it to get back here.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lucky fer us, we didn't bump into any cops. Last thing you want's a ticket poppin' up on the doormat. That'd be a month of Texas's take-home down the drain.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: In other words! Texas put her own salary on the line to rush back over here, so don't blame her, Boss.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, what'cha got?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You gonna let the girls leave you their messes to clean up like that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's whatever.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ugh. Lame.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Because I'm so magnanimous, I won't make a fuss over y'all being slower than a bad dump. Now, where's my stuff?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Right here.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now we're talkin'! Yo Exu, I need my chair and those fancy electric specs!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Coming right up, Boss!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What'd you get this time? Huh... This box is pretty heavy. Some kind of machinery?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh! I think that logo and the controller shape's givin' me a clue...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's gotta be the thingy majigger what's all sold outta the markets... some last-generation vidja games console? I heard some rich folks have been buyin' 'em up, top dollar.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Heh, games. Who's to say that life ain't just one big game?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, hook it up.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This line here?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, we got a picture!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hrmm, oh? Looks like a side-scrolling racing game... direction keys, accelerator...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And then, what's this button here? Is this supposed to be a bomb?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: T'ain't no bomb. Looks a bit more like...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: An Originium rocket launcher.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I knew it!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wait a minute, ain't this one of them games, the kind where you dodge obstacles and whatnot 'til you get to the end? Why'd they put in a Originium rocket launcher...?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You damned fool! Like hiding and dodging is the only way to reach the end?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I get it now, you can just charge forward in a straight line and send anything in your way packing! Now that's the kind of game I like, nice and simple rules.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Looks like the controls are working just fine. And I think it's even got a two-player mode!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Say, Boss, wanna give it a shot?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You challengin' me to a match? What's the fun in playin' a game you know you'll win?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, you're up.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Great, I got full ammo. Watch this!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You went and blew up all them buildings in yer way. Sounds about right fer you, actually...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hahaha! What's wrong with taking down a building or two? I'm gonna win this round for sure!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...You're wide open!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Fires an explosive at the opposite lane)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: They let'cha shoot at the other player's lane?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nobody said you can't.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Indeed, nobody said you can't. But if you're gonna pull that trick on me, don't blame me for what happens next...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: As they say, an eye for an eye! What goes around, comes around! Dodge this if you can, I'm gonna blow you away!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wh-What the heck, you'n just go and shoot the other car too?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Nobody said you can't, right? Hehe, I'm going for the gold, baby!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hm? Somebody at the door.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Good afternoon, everyone.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What are you playing? All the yelling and screaming spooked me at the door.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, if it ain't Sora! C'mon in, take a seat. Exusiai and Texas're playin' vidja games. Baws got his flippers on an old game console, and he's lettin' us have first go at it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wanna play?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Video games? I think I'll pass, I'm no good at those.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, by the way, I grabbed the mail on my way in. Are you sure you can keep this up? There's a whole mountain of bills this month...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And one more thing... here, there's something for you, Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mail, for me? Wonder if it's a bill, or a challenge.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ehh, I'm sure it's not the diploma that the school was supposed to reissue, right...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whassat? You never got yer graduation diploma?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course I got it!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's just, uh, the last time I got in a fight with the gang, I accidentally burnt it all along with the fake bank notes and the fake diploma the Boss made us.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I even reminded you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did you now? Sorry, I don't seem to remember that at all!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That does sound like something you'd do.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But this letter looks like a pretty ordinary, personal letter. It probably isn't any of the things you just listed off...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hard to say.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, Croissant, here's the controller. Take my spot for a bit.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Can do!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm, let's take a look.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Huh, it's from my sister..

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Now that I think about it, I did run into a Laterano Messenger earlier today.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, if she wrote this whole thick stack of stuff, she must really be worried sick...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Exusiai's sister?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait, hold on a second, why do I seem to recall that your sister was in some kind of accident...? Isn't that why you came all the way to Lungmen looking for Mostima?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm? That sounds right to me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: My sister was in an accident a number of years back, and ended up in a deep coma, in the hospital for a long time...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But, she had already woken up by the time I left Laterano!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? What's wrong, Sora? Why do you look like you just saw the Boss gyrating while singing some sappy love song?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Where'd you get that overly specific example from anyway? My eyes already hurt just thinking about it!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Uhh... nothing, don't mind me. It's just, I sometimes feel stupid for genuinely worrying about you...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ah, lemme guess... You didn't happen to misunderstand something before, did you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh, really? You serious?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Though my sister did have some pretty severe injuries, she's been gradually recovering. Otherwise, how could I just ditch her and run around the world?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You do have a point.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, I can't blame you for misunderstanding. After all, things did look pretty dicey back then.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And I thought someone like her never could've gotten hurt like that. But there she was, her bloodied, unconscious body...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: B-Bloody?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah, things got way crazier that time than what we normally get into.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I always thought I was a pretty brave girl, but I clearly remember being scared into a cold sweat. Just thinking about it now still makes my hands shake.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not even kidding. At the time, I hadn't sorted things through in my head, and I nearly jumped into a fight with the one who brought my sister back.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I can imagine...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But, that person you just mentioned... was that Mostima?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bingo, the very same. After bringing my sister back, she immediately disappeared to Lord-knows-where.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Even after my sister regained consciousness, she wouldn't tell me what happened...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: How could I go on without knowing the whole story?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So basically, I just wanted to find out what happened. I chased Mostima all the way from Laterano to Lungmen, and that's when I met the Boss.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Um, how do I put it... So it's like...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That whole thing with you joining up, plus the fact that you always try to cut the conversation short every time Mostima's name comes up, I just assumed you had some bad blood with her.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If we're talking about how Mostima always dragged my sister into working overtime, and how many times that ended with me getting stood up, then yeah, we do have some bad blood.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh? You knew each other as kids?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hmm... Darn it, I can't paint a mental picture of your sister at all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Just the thought of there being another person like you is already giving me a headache.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Haha, don't you worry about that. She and I are very different.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah. After all, we don't share any blood.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hwuh?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No foolin'?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course... Wait, Croissant, how come you're listening in?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You ain't never talked about yer past. I'm so curious I just can't help mahself...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I don't talk about my past?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, let's save the story for later! Don't get distracted. Just keep gaming!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: —Too late.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I win.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ahhhh! Texas! That's darn underhanded to pass me up like that!!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh... Total defeat.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Everyone sure is curious.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (But, did I really never bring up the thing with my sister before?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Well, I guess it's not altogether surprising, since nobody bothered asking...)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Speaking of Mostima, I've been waiting for eons now and she still hasn't shown up. Is the Boss trying to pull a fast one on me?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Whatever, I'll just have to go with the flow! First, gotta write a response though...)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm, wonder if we have any snacks that won't go bad or break...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, Exusiai, where are you going? Not going to play anymore?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Right, you guys have fun. I'm going to go shopping for some nice gifts. Be right back~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We'll have a rematch later tonight, Texas! That round just now didn't count, so let's have a redo!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hehe, just you wait! I'm gonna win for sure!
